reconstructed_values.carrier_envelope_note: Carrier length, overall width and height are conservative presentation values. The published 3.05-4.06 m figure is wheel tread, not overall width.
reconstructed_values.selected_boom_span_note: Manufacturer-published 120 ft selected working width retained as the deployed lateral display envelope; truss segments, pivots, fold geometry and breakaways remain reconstructed.
reconstructed_values.tank_visualization: Neutral exterior tank cue for the published 1,200 U.S. gallon capacity; no internal volume, liquid or plumbing simulation.
reconstructed_values.materials: Neutral unbranded slate, graphite, steel, rubber and glass; no logos, decals or copied trade dress.
reconstructed_values.all_animation_ranges: Conservative presentation ranges, not operator limits.

unresolved_choices: complete carrier longitudinal, vertical and folded lateral envelopes
exact tire code, wheel offset and tread setting
all suspension, steering, tread-adjustment, boom and breakaway pivots
tank mounts, pump, valve, hose and nozzle geometry
exact exterior surfacing and service-detail placement
mechanical_gaps: Boom fold and axle oscillation are bounded visual articulations without terrain, suspension, steering, hydraulic or collision physics.
Boom plumbing and nozzle marks do not simulate pressure, rate, droplets, wind, section control or application coverage.
Powertrain, wheel motors, suspension internals, tank internals and hydraulic systems are not modeled as engineering assemblies.
